name: Amelia
source:
Amelia is a character used as an image of the radical extremist side of U.K. internet politics. 
She persuades the main characters into participating in extremist behavior; such as engaging in "harmful" political ideologies, and participating in protests.
Amelia complains about the increasing amount of immigrants that are coming to U.K., spreading this cause on social media.
